heading: Scintillator and SiPM
content: A 5 × 5 × 1 cm plastic scintillator turns each passing particle into a flash of light. A 6 × 6 mm silicon photomultiplier counts the photons.

heading: Fast, low-noise electronics
content: Custom analog shaping and a Raspberry Pi Pico give a 12-bit pulse-height measurement, 400 µs dead time and up to 700 events per second.

heading: Sensors on every event
content: Temperature, barometric pressure, acceleration and rotation are logged with each event, so you can study weather and motion along with the rate.

heading: Takes it anywhere
content: It draws 0.5 W and weighs 110 g in its aluminum case. Detectors have flown on airplanes, balloons, sounding rockets and the ISS.
